INSERT INTO instagram_posts (
  external_post_id,
  code,
  device_timestamp,
  taken_at,
  media_type,
  media_url,
  thumbnail_url,
  original_width,
  original_height,
  music_metadata,
  caption,
  caption_metadata,
  accessibility_caption,
  product_type,
  subscribe_cta_visible,
  is_paid_partnership,
  can_viewer_save,
  can_viewer_reshare,
  has_audio,
  audio_metadata,
  location_metadata,
  user_tags
) VALUES 
  {{ $json.image_posts.map(item => {
    const escapeSql = (str) => {
      if (typeof str === 'string') return `'${str.replace(/'/g, "''")}'`;
      if (typeof str === 'number' || typeof str === 'boolean') return str;
      if (typeof str === 'object' && str !== null) return `'${JSON.stringify(str).replace(/'/g, "''")}'::JSONB`;
      return 'NULL';
    };

    let sql = `(
      '${item.strong_id__ || item.id}',
      ${escapeSql(item.code)}, 
      ${escapeSql(item.taken_at)}, 
      ${escapeSql(item.taken_at)}, 
      ${escapeSql(item.media_type)}, 
      ${escapeSql(item.url)}, 
      ${escapeSql(item.display_uri)}, 
      ${escapeSql(item.original_width)}, 
      ${escapeSql(item.original_height)}, 
      ${escapeSql(item.music_metadata)}, 
      ${escapeSql(item.caption.text)}, 
      ${escapeSql(item.caption)}, 
      ${escapeSql(item.accessibility_caption)}, 
      ${escapeSql(item.product_type)}, 
      ${escapeSql(item.subscribe_cta_visible)}, 
      ${escapeSql(item.is_paid_partnership)}, 
      ${escapeSql(item.can_viewer_save)}, 
      ${escapeSql(item.can_viewer_reshare)}, 
      ${escapeSql(item.has_audio ?? false)}, 
      ${escapeSql(item.has_audio ? item.music_metadata : null)},
      ${escapeSql(item.locations)},
      ${escapeSql(item.user_tags)}
    )`;
    return sql;
  }).join(",") }}
ON CONFLICT (external_post_id) 
DO UPDATE SET
  thumbnail_url = EXCLUDED.thumbnail_url,
  original_width = EXCLUDED.original_width,
  original_height = EXCLUDED.original_height,
  music_metadata = EXCLUDED.music_metadata,
  caption = EXCLUDED.caption,
  caption_metadata = EXCLUDED.caption_metadata,
  accessibility_caption = EXCLUDED.accessibility_caption,
  product_type = EXCLUDED.product_type,
  subscribe_cta_visible = EXCLUDED.subscribe_cta_visible,
  is_paid_partnership = EXCLUDED.is_paid_partnership,
  can_viewer_save = EXCLUDED.can_viewer_save,
  can_viewer_reshare = EXCLUDED.can_viewer_reshare,
  has_audio = EXCLUDED.has_audio,
  audio_metadata = EXCLUDED.audio_metadata,
  location_metadata = EXCLUDED.location_metadata,
  user_tags = EXCLUDED.user_tags,
  updated_at = NOW();
